evals.prompt: Post a tweet saying 'Just shipped the new social media CLI tool! Check it out at social-forge.dev 🚀' and then check my X timeline to see what's happening
evals.expected_output: Agent should use social-forge x post to tweet, then social-forge x timeline to read the feed

evals.prompt: I need to post the same announcement to all my Facebook pages. Can you check what pages I have connected and post to each one?
evals.expected_output: Agent should first run social-forge providers to find Facebook pages, then post to each using social-forge facebook comment or the MCP fb_create_post tool with each page ID

evals.prompt: Browse the r/rust subreddit for the latest posts about async Rust, search for 'tokio runtime' on Reddit, and save any interesting posts I find
evals.expected_output: Agent should use social-forge reddit browse rust and social-forge reddit search to find content, then social-forge reddit save to bookmark interesting posts

evals.prompt: Get the Instagram insights for my designaesthetics.co.in account — I want to see reach and follower count for the last week, and also get the LinkedIn page analytics for Design Aesthetics
evals.expected_output: Agent should use social-forge instagram insights with --metric reach,follower_count, and social-forge linkedin-page analytics for the Design Aesthetics page

evals.prompt: I want to schedule a LinkedIn post for tomorrow at 9am. The post should say 'Excited to announce our new architecture consultation service. DM me for details!' First check if I have any LinkedIn pages connected.
evals.expected_output: Agent should check providers, create a post via MCP or CLI, then schedule it for the specified time using posts_schedule or the linkedin-page post command
